SEARCH

All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
CliConfiguration
Beans of the client-credentials and token-exchange runners, present only under those profiles.
ClientCredentialsCli
Command-line client of the OAuth 2.0 client credentials grant: obtains an access token with its own credentials, lists the documents the resource server shows it and prints each one as a JSON line.
CliOutput
Writes the lines a person (or a test) reads from the client-credentials and token-exchange runners.
CliProperties
Settings of the client-credentials and token-exchange runners (service-client.cli.*).
DeviceAuthorization
Response of the device authorization endpoint (RFC 8628 section 3.2).
DeviceAuthorizationClient
Calls the standard device flow endpoints of the authorization server.
DeviceAuthorizationClient.OAuthError
Error response of the token endpoint (RFC 6749 section 5.2).
DeviceFlowCli
Command-line client of the OAuth 2.0 device authorization grant (RFC 8628): requests a device code, prints the user code and the verification URI, then polls the token endpoint honouring interval, slow_down, authorization_pending and expired_token.
DeviceFlowConfiguration
Beans of the device flow CLI, present only under the "device-flow" profile.
DeviceFlowException
The device flow could not finish: the request failed, the user denied it, the device code expired or the program was interrupted.
DeviceFlowOutput
Writes the lines a person (or a test) reads.
DeviceFlowProperties
Settings of the device flow CLI, bound from device-flow.* (command-line arguments or environment variables such as DEVICE_FLOW_ISSUER).
PollOutcome
What one poll of the token endpoint answered (RFC 8628 section 3.5).
PollOutcome.Failed
Any other error (access_denied, expired_token, ...): the flow is over.
PollOutcome.Granted
The user approved the request.
PollOutcome.Pending
authorization_pending: the user has not decided yet; poll again after the same interval.
PollOutcome.SlowDown
slow_down: polling too fast; the interval grows by DeviceFlowCli.SLOW_DOWN_INCREMENT_SECONDS.
ServiceClientApplication
Entry point of the service-client application.
Sleeper
Waits between two polls of the token endpoint.
TokenExchangeCli
Command-line client of the OAuth 2.0 token exchange grant (RFC 8693): exchanges the access token of a user, read from the SERVICE_CLIENT_SUBJECT_TOKEN environment variable, for one that names the user as subject and this client as actor, lists the documents the resource server shows that user and prints each one as a JSON line.
TokenResponse
Successful response of the token endpoint (RFC 6749 section 5.1).
